items.html: And the one who understands will comprehend all the details of this verse: the matter of this going out from before the king is Rachel, and the "great crown of gold" is from the side of the Atarah of the Yesod of Aba. Therefore it is called "great," for Hesed and Hochma are called Gedulah — "the great, the mighty, and the awesome" — the foundation. Also, one who delves deeply will comprehend that they are of the tribe of Benjamin. And this suffices.
